notes.title: Подписчики Xbox Game Pass получат во второй половине февраля четыре игры — Microsoft опубликовала список
notes.notes: Microsoft официально анонсировала вторую волну игр для подписчиков Xbox Game Pass на февраль. Всего игроки получат в ближайшие две недели четыре игры — первая появится в каталоге 28 февраля, а последняя — 3 марта. Это будет громкая новинка Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty от разработчиков Nioh.

notes.title: Инсайдер: Прошлогодняя JRPG Soul Hackers 2 от Atlus скоро появится в подписке Xbox Game Pass
notes.notes: Ролевая игра Soul Hackers 2 студии Atlus в скором времени станет частью подписки Xbox Game Pass. Соответствующей информацией поделился инсайдер eXtas1s, раскрывший недавно ремастеры JRPG-дилогии Baten Kaitos до официального анонса.

notes.title: Soul Hackers 2 Ver. 1.02
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Soul Hackers 2! This release is Soul Hackers 2, version 1.02. 

 A full list of changes can be found below: 

 

Newly added functions: 

■ Dash function 

A "Dash" function has been added to Ringo’s movement. 

The user can toggle between "Normal" and "Dash" at will. While in Dash Mode, Ringo's walking and slashing speeds will increase. 

Due to the addition of the dash function, the effect of the Summoner Skill "Assassin's Steps" has been changed to: "For a given distance, enemies will ignore Ringo." 

 

■ Fast Battle Mode 

A "Speed Up" mode has been added to battles. Players may freely toggle between normal and high-speed combat. 

 

■ Adjustments 

Adjusted how long loading-screen tips are shown. 

Changed the flow of on-screen prompts during soul level increase to reduce the risk of incorrect input from accidental button presses. 

Added the ability to teleport directly to shops from the City Map. 

Adjusted enemy spawn rate in dungeons. 

Adjusted skill inheritance rates during demon fusion. 

Other minor changes. 

 

■ Other changes 

Added four new demons: Pixie (Soul Hackers Ver.), Neko Shogun, Aitvaras, and Isis. 

Note: The above bonus demons do not count toward the Registration Percentage in the Demon Compendium or the achievement "Compendium Completionist".
 

Thank you again for your continued support of Soul Hackers 2!

Amidst the glimmer of futuristic Japan, war is brewing between the Yatagarasu and the Phantom Society: two factions of Devil Summoners seeking to shape the future of the world. Meanwhile, the digital hivemind, Aion, foresees a world-ending catastrophe and calls forth the AI beings Ringo and Figue to alter the course of the future.   

Ringo will need to soul hack three Devil Summoners – Arrow, Milady, and Saizo – whose fates are tied to the end of the world. Can their ragtag group decrypt their shared destiny, or will their world fall to ruin?
